models.measure_description: Measured on an X50 Ultra Complete robot (RLX85CE-5) with base station RCXE0109, using a Shelly Plus 1PM in the socket feeding the base station, so every number covers the whole station rather than battery charging alone. Station settings during the runs: smart mop washing on, self clean on, mop washing with detergent on, UV sterilization on, auto drying on, silent drying off, drying time 3h. With smart mop washing on the machine selects water temperature and washing program itself and both selects read unavailable; the stored manual values are hot and standard. The heater does run under this configuration, 937 W for about 14 s during the end of job wash. Measuring the four manual settings separately gives 27.7 W on normal, where the heater never fires, 92.9 W on mild, 106.6 W on warm and 110.3 W on hot; smart washing sits between warm and hot. The washing branch carries the smart washing figure since that is the default. Fixed values are time averages over the window in which each condition holds, not peaks.

models.measure_description: Measured on a Shelly Plus 1PM, one mode at a time, 30 samples per point after 120 s settling. The device has two independently switchable indicators that draw significant power: the display/button backlight (light entity with translation_key display_backlight, +0.48 W) and the air quality ring (translation_key light_brightness, +1.03 W). All base values were measured with both verified off; the surcharges are folded into the conditional branches. Note the device switches its indicators back on by itself on every mode change, so each point was re-measured until the indicator state held for the whole window. LIMITATION: the ring is the air quality indicator and changes colour, so its 1.03 W applies to the colour present during measurement (blue / good air). LIMITATION: the 'auto' preset reports no percentage and varies with air quality (observed 7.3-13.4 W over 3 min); it is deliberately not covered, so powercalc reports no value in that mode rather than a wrong one.
